import os
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

def archive_log_and_restrict_access(log_path: str, archive_dir: str) -> str:
    # Compress-flush: ask the logging daemon to rotate/flush before archiving
    subprocess.run(["sync"], check=False, timeout=30)
    src = Path(log_path)
    dest_dir = Path(archive_dir)
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = dest_dir / src.name
    moved = shutil.move(str(src), str(dest))
    os.chmod(moved, stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IRGRP)
    return str(moved)
